user-stories.text: Open a run report in a new tab while public browsing remains available. Use the account page to sign out.

data-flow.text: The dashboard sends only a public run identifier. The proxy checks GitHub identity and active team membership, then privately redirects to Antithesis.

acceptance.text: Validate identifiers and isolate navigation. Public assets and browser application storage contain no report URLs or credentials.

verification.text: Execute renderer regressions and real browser navigation on phone and desktop. Keep backend and denied-account acceptance separate.

boundaries.text: This UI preserves the existing proxy session design and does not change authorization or token custody.
